request.prompt: Create one isolated full-body game asset of the Rachni Worker from the original Mass Effect 1, faithfully matching the supplied actual in-game reference. Use exactly the same elevated three-quarter view and planted pose, with the small tapered head toward the lower left and the rounded segmented abdomen toward the upper right. Preserve the reference's green and dark mottled shell, slender four walking legs, their angular joints and pointed tips, the short mouth appendages, the head-to-abdomen proportions and the readable asymmetric occlusion of the far limbs. This is the green final in-game worker: do not substitute the red creature from early guide artwork, a Rachni Soldier, or a new creature design. Preserve the original restrained game-model surface detail; do not embellish it with extra eyes, spikes, wings, antennae, limbs, armor, slime, or photorealistic insect details. Exactly one creature, entire silhouette contained in the canvas, including every visible leg tip and mouth appendage, with at least 9 percent clear margins on every side. Keep the pose and perspective so no unseen backside needs invention. Remove only the room, floor and floor shadow. Transparent background with real alpha; no platform, scene, text, border, glow outline or contact shadow. Neutral readable illumination that keeps the green mottling and existing form, crisp game-art edges. One subject, one view; no sheet, no collage. The attached image is the controlling identity, anatomy, palette, and pose reference.
